MAIN.FG_System.name: FG_System

MAIN.FG_System.label: 系統

MAIN.FG_System.Doors.name: Doors

en.Function: Enclosure doors and their safety locks. Three doors on each of the two accessible sides.

MAIN.FG_System.Doors.label: 系統 · 安全門
MAIN.FG_System.Doors.function: 圍欄門及其安全鎖。兩個可進入側的每一側各有三扇門。

MAIN.FG_System.B_SafetyDoor11.name: B_SafetyDoor11

en.Function: Safety interlock on an enclosure door, side 1. Reports door position and holds the door locked while the cell may move.
en.Signal: Two inputs back - closed and locked - and one lock coil out. Secure means BOTH: closed alone is not enough.

MAIN.FG_System.B_SafetyDoor11.label: 系統 · 安全門 11
MAIN.FG_System.B_SafetyDoor11.function: 側 1 圍欄門上的安全互鎖。回報門位置，並在單元可能移動時保持門鎖定狀態。
MAIN.FG_System.B_SafetyDoor11.signal: 兩個輸入回傳 - 關閉與鎖定 - 以及一個鎖定線圈輸出。安全意味著兩者皆滿足：僅關閉是不夠的。

MAIN.FG_System.H_SignalTower.name: H_SignalTower

en.Function: Four colour signal tower. Samples its red, yellow, blue and green lamps into one PLC symbol.
en.Signal: PanelSampler. Aggregates the four tower lamps into one FB_Panel DWORD, with the lamps own links disabled. Same packing mechanism as the control panel.

MAIN.FG_System.H_SignalTower.label: 三色燈 · 總成
MAIN.FG_System.H_SignalTower.function: 四色三色燈。將其紅色、黃色、藍色和綠色燈號採樣至一個 PLC 符號中。
MAIN.FG_System.H_SignalTower.signal: PanelSampler。將四個三色燈燈號聚合至一個 FB_Panel DWORD，並禁用燈號自身的連結。封裝機制與操作面板相同。

MAIN.FG_System.RED.name: RED

en.Function: Signal tower lamp segment. Its meaning is given by the Role entry on each instance.
en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol in its own right - its own Link is disabled by the PanelSampler. Reached as bit 0 of the H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD.
en.Role: Assumed from the colour, not confirmed by code: fault or stopped.

MAIN.FG_System.RED.label: 三色燈 · 紅燈
MAIN.FG_System.RED.function: 三色燈燈段。其含義由每個實例的 Role 條目定義。
MAIN.FG_System.RED.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其自身的連結被 PanelSampler 禁用。透過 H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD 的第 0 位元存取。
MAIN.FG_System.RED.role: 根據顏色推斷，未經程式碼確認：故障或停止。

MAIN.FG_System.YELLOW.name: YELLOW

en.Function: Signal tower lamp segment. Its meaning is given by the Role entry.
en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol in its own right - its own Link is disabled by the PanelSampler. Reached as bit 1 of the H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD.
en.Role: Assumed from the colour, not confirmed by code: warning, or ready and waiting.

MAIN.FG_System.YELLOW.label: 三色燈 · 黃燈
MAIN.FG_System.YELLOW.function: 三色燈燈段。其含義由 Role 條目定義。
MAIN.FG_System.YELLOW.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其自身的連結被 PanelSampler 禁用。透過 H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD 的第 1 位元存取。
MAIN.FG_System.YELLOW.role: 根據顏色推斷，未經程式碼確認：警告，或準備就緒等待中。

MAIN.FG_System.BLUE.name: BLUE

en.Function: Signal tower lamp segment. Its meaning is given by the Role entry.
en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol in its own right - its own Link is disabled by the PanelSampler. Reached as bit 2 of the H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD.

MAIN.FG_System.BLUE.label: 三色燈 · 藍燈
MAIN.FG_System.BLUE.function: 三色燈燈段。其含義由 Role 條目定義。
MAIN.FG_System.BLUE.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其自身的連結被 PanelSampler 禁用。透過 H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD 的第 2 位元存取。

MAIN.FG_System.GREEN.name: GREEN

en.Function: Signal tower lamp segment. Its meaning is given by the Role entry.
en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol in its own right - its own Link is disabled by the PanelSampler. Reached as bit 3 of the H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD.
en.Role: Assumed from the colour, not confirmed by code: running normally.

MAIN.FG_System.GREEN.label: 三色燈 · 綠燈
MAIN.FG_System.GREEN.function: 三色燈燈段。其含義由 Role 條目定義。
MAIN.FG_System.GREEN.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其自身的連結被 PanelSampler 禁用。透過 H_SignalTower FB_Panel DWORD 的第 3 位元存取。
MAIN.FG_System.GREEN.role: 根據顏色推斷，未經程式碼確認：正常運行。

MAIN.FG_System.H_ControlPanel.name: H_ControlPanel

en.Function: Main operator panel, TwinCAT/Beckhoff variant. Samples eight push buttons - five PackML machine commands and three mode selections - into one PLC symbol, and lights each button back from it.
en.Signal: PanelSampler. Disables its children's individual communication and exposes one aggregated FB_Panel DWORD, packing their status bits in and unpacking control bits back.

MAIN.FG_System.H_ControlPanel.label: 操作面板 · 總成
MAIN.FG_System.H_ControlPanel.function: 主操作面板，TwinCAT/Beckhoff 版本。將八個按鈕（五個 PackML 機器指令和三個模式選擇）採樣至一個 PLC 符號中，並從中回饋每個按鈕的燈號。
MAIN.FG_System.H_ControlPanel.signal: PanelSampler。禁用其子元件的個別通訊，並提供一個聚合的 FB_Panel DWORD，將狀態位元封裝進去並將控制位元解封回傳。

MAIN.FG_System.START.name: START

en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol in its own right - its own Link is disabled by the PanelSampler. Pressed state is bit 0 of the H_ControlPanel FB_Panel StatusData; its feedback lamp is bit 0 of ControlData.

MAIN.FG_System.START.label: 操作面板 · 啟動鈕
MAIN.FG_System.START.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其自身的連結被 PanelSampler 禁用。按下狀態為 H_ControlPanel FB_Panel StatusData 的第 0 位元；其回饋燈為 ControlData 的第 0 位元。

MAIN.FG_System.RESET.name: RESET

en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol in its own right - its own Link is disabled by the PanelSampler. Pressed state is bit 1 of the H_ControlPanel FB_Panel StatusData; its feedback lamp is bit 1 of ControlData.

MAIN.FG_System.RESET.label: 操作面板 · 重設按鈕
MAIN.FG_System.RESET.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其連結由 PanelSampler 禁用。按下狀態為 H_ControlPanel FB_Panel StatusData 的第 1 位元；其回饋燈為 ControlData 的第 1 位元。

MAIN.FG_System.STOP.label: 操作面板 · 停止按鈕

MAIN.FG_System.CLEAR.label: 操作面板 · 清除按鈕

MAIN.FG_System.ABORT.label: 操作面板 · 中止按鈕
MAIN.FG_System.ABORT.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其連結由 PanelSampler 禁用。按下狀態為 H_ControlPanel FB_Panel StatusData 的第 4 位元；其回饋燈為 ControlData 的第 4 位元。

MAIN.FG_System.PRODUCTION.label: 操作面板 · 生產按鈕
MAIN.FG_System.PRODUCTION.signal: 本身並非 PLC 符號 - 其連結由 PanelSampler 禁用。按下狀態為 H_ControlPanel FB_Panel StatusData 的第 5 位元；其回饋燈為 ControlData 的第 5 位元。

MAIN.FG_System.MAINTANANCE.label: 操作面板 · 維護按鈕

MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop1.name: SS_EStop1

en.Function: Emergency stop, position 1. Latching mushroom actuator that drops the cell to a safe state.
en.Signal: One input and one lamp coil, as a single device. Active while the mushroom is latched.

MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop1.label: 系統 · 緊急停止 1
MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop1.function: 緊急停止，位置 1。自鎖式蘑菇頭致動器，將工作單元切換至安全狀態。
MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop1.signal: 作為單一裝置，包含一個輸入端和一個燈號線圈。當蘑菇頭處於自鎖狀態時為啟動。

MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop2.name: SS_EStop2

en.Function: Emergency stop, position 2. Latching mushroom actuator that drops the cell to a safe state.
en.Signal: One input and one lamp coil, as a single device. Active while the mushroom is latched.

MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop2.label: 緊急停止 2
MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop2.function: 緊急停止，位置 2。鎖定式蘑菇頭致動器，將單元切換至安全狀態。
MAIN.FG_System.SS_EStop2.signal: 單一裝置包含一個輸入與一個燈圈。當蘑菇頭鎖定時處於啟動狀態。

MAIN.FG_Transport.name: FG_Transport

en.Function: Two level pallet conveyor in the Bosch TS style. Circulates pallets past the five processing stations and returns them.

MAIN.FG_Transport.label: 輸送系統
MAIN.FG_Transport.function: Bosch TS 風格的雙層托盤輸送帶。使托盤在五個加工站之間循環並返回。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01.name: Transport01

en.Function: Straight conveyor section carrying pallets between transfer points.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01.label: 主輸送帶 1
MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01.function: 承載托盤在轉移點之間移動的直線輸送帶段。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01_M_Conveyor.name: M_Conveyor

en.Function: Conveyor drive for a straight transport section. Runs continuously while MIL is enabled.
en.Signal: Simple drive: forward and backward run bits out, one drive-active bit back. No speed reference and no encoder.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01_M_Conveyor.label: 主輸送帶 1 · 馬達
MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01_M_Conveyor.function: 直線輸送帶段的輸送帶驅動裝置。在 MIL 啟用時持續運行。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport01_M_Conveyor.signal: 簡單驅動：輸出正轉與反轉運行位元，回傳一個驅動啟動位元。無速度參考且無編碼器。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02.name: Transport02

en.Function: Straight conveyor section carrying pallets between transfer points.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02.label: 主輸送帶 2
MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02.function: 承載托盤在轉移點之間移動的直線輸送帶段。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02_M_Conveyor.name: M_Conveyor

en.Function: Conveyor drive for a straight transport section. Runs continuously while MIL is enabled.
en.Signal: Simple drive: forward and backward run bits out, one drive-active bit back. No speed reference and no encoder.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02_M_Conveyor.label: 主輸送帶 2 · 馬達
MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02_M_Conveyor.function: 直線輸送帶段的輸送帶驅動裝置。在 MIL 啟用時持續運行。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Transport02_M_Conveyor.signal: 簡單驅動：輸出正轉與反轉運行位元，回傳一個驅動啟動位元。無速度參考且無編碼器。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01.name: Lift01

en.Function: Vertical transfer between the two conveyor levels. Takes a pallet on its own short conveyor, moves it to the other level and hands it on.
en.Role: Lift 1. Raises pallets from the lower accumulation level to the upper processing level, feeding Index01.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01.label: 升降機 1
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01.function: 兩個輸送帶層級之間的垂直轉移。透過其自身的短輸送帶接收托盤，將其移動到另一層級並進行交接。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01.role: 升降機 1。將托盤從下層堆積層提升至上層加工層，供給分度站 1。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Y_Lift.name: Y_Lift

en.Function: Lift cylinder. Drives the carriage between the lower and upper conveyor levels.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Moves the carriage between the lower and upper conveyor levels.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Y_Lift.label: 升降機 1 · 氣缸
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Y_Lift.function: 升降氣缸。驅動載台在下層與上層輸送帶層級之間移動。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Y_Lift.signal: 雙電磁閥並讀取兩個到位感測器。將載台在下層與上層輸送帶層級之間移動。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Axis_Lift.name: Axis_Lift

en.Function: Kinematic axis of the lift carriage, driven by Y_Lift.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Axis_Lift.label: 升降機 1 · 升降軸
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_Axis_Lift.function: 升降機台車的運動軸，由 Y_Lift 驅動。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_TU_Linear.name: TU_Linear

en.Function: Short conveyor section mounted on the lift carriage, used to draw a pallet on and push it off.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_TU_Linear.label: 升降機 1 · 線性輸送帶
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_TU_Linear.function: 安裝在升降機台車上的短輸送帶段，用於將托盤拉入並推離。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_M_Conveyor.name: M_Conveyor

en.Function: Drive for the conveyor section on the lift carriage.
en.Signal: Simple drive: forward and backward run bits out, one drive-active bit back. No speed reference and no encoder.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_M_Conveyor.label: 升降機 1 · 輸送帶馬達
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_M_Conveyor.function: 升降機台車上輸送帶段的驅動裝置。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_M_Conveyor.signal: 簡易驅動：輸出正轉與反轉位元，回傳一個驅動啟動位元。無速度參考值且無編碼器。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Detect.name: B_Detect

en.Function: Presence sensor on the lift carriage. Confirms a pallet is aboard before the carriage moves.
en.Signal: Binary presence sensor. Active while a pallet is at this station. Occupied and CanAccept are computed from it.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Detect.label: 升降機 1 · 偵測感測器
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Detect.function: 升降機台車上的存在感測器。在台車移動前確認托盤已在車上。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Detect.signal: 二進位存在感測器。當托盤位於此站時為啟動狀態。Occupied 與 CanAccept 是由其計算而得。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Exit.name: B_Exit

en.Function: Exit sensor on the lift. Confirms the pallet has transferred off the carriage.
en.Signal: Binary presence sensor. Its RISING EDGE clears the transfer latch, in every PackML state. Read the edge, never the level.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Exit.label: 升降機 1 · 出口感測器
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Exit.function: 升降機上的出口感測器。確認托盤已從台車交接離去。
MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift01_B_Exit.signal: 二進位存在感測器。其上升沿在任何 PackML 狀態下都會清除交接鎖存。請讀取上升沿而非電位。

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift02.name: Lift02

en.Function: Vertical transfer between the two conveyor levels. Takes a pallet on its own short conveyor, moves it to the other level and hands it on.
en.Role: Lift 2. Lowers pallets from the upper level after FG_05 onto the return conveyor.

MAIN.FG_Transport.Lift02.label: 升降機 2

MAIN.FG_Transport.Stopper01_B_Exit.signal: 二進位存在感測器。其上升沿會在所有 PackML 狀態下清除傳輸鎖存。請讀取邊緣而非電位。

MAIN.FG_01.name: FG_01
MAIN.FG_01.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Identifies the payload and applies a laser mark. The camera reads the serial number the part carries; the mark content is abstract, and FG_02 reads it back.

MAIN.FG_01.label: 第 1 站
MAIN.FG_01.function: 識別工件並進行雷射打標。攝影機讀取工件攜帶的序號；標記內容為抽象的，由 FG_02 讀回。

MAIN.FG_01.Barcode Reader.name: Barcode Reader
MAIN.FG_01.Barcode Reader.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Verification sub assembly - the optical reader behind a pneumatic window that shields it while the laser fires.

MAIN.FG_01.Barcode Reader.label: 第 1 站 · 讀碼器
MAIN.FG_01.Barcode Reader.function: 驗證子組件 —— 位於氣動窗後方的光學讀碼器，在雷射發射時對其進行屏蔽。

MAIN.FG_01.P_Camera.name: P_Camera
MAIN.FG_01.P_Camera.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Reads the serial number the payload carries. It runs after the laser fires but does not verify the mark - FG_02 does that.
en.Signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

MAIN.FG_01.P_Camera.label: 第 1 站 · 攝影機
MAIN.FG_01.P_Camera.function: 讀取工件攜帶的序號。它在雷射發射後運行，但不驗證標記 —— 該工作由 FG_02 完成。
MAIN.FG_01.P_Camera.signal: 啟用，然後觸發；讀回 Ready, Busy, ResultValid 和 ResultOK。孿生會回顯兩個控制位並交接數據；判定結果在 OC_SIM FB_Camera 中綜合得出。

MAIN.FG_01.Y_ReaderWindow.name: Y_ReaderWindow
MAIN.FG_01.Y_ReaderWindow.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Pneumatic window in front of P_Reader, doubling as the camera shield. Closed while the laser fires, opened for the read.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED opens the window for the read; retracted shields the optics and is home.

MAIN.FG_01.Y_ReaderWindow.label: 第 1 站 · 讀碼窗氣缸
MAIN.FG_01.Y_ReaderWindow.function: 位於讀碼器前的氣動窗，同時作為相機遮蔽罩。雷射發射時關閉，讀碼時開啟。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_ReaderWindow.signal: 雙電磁閥且讀取兩個到位感測器。伸出開啟視窗以進行讀碼；縮回則遮蔽光學元件且為原點。

MAIN.FG_01.Laser Unit.name: Laser Unit
MAIN.FG_01.Laser Unit.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Marking sub assembly - the laser head, its service mode platform cylinder and the kinematic axis they ride on.

MAIN.FG_01.Laser Unit.label: 第 1 站 · 雷射單元
MAIN.FG_01.Laser Unit.function: 打標子組件 — 包括雷射頭、其維修模式平台氣缸以及承載它們的運動軸。

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Platform.name: Y_Platform
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Platform.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Moves the laser head. Service mode only - SequenceUnit1 takes override control of it on enable and releases on disable, but never actuates it during the normal cycle.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Service positioning of the laser head. Never actuated during the production cycle.

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Platform.label: 第 1 站 · 平台氣缸
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Platform.function: 移動雷射頭。僅限維修模式 — SequenceUnit1 在啟用時接管其控制權，在停用時釋放，但在正常週期中絕不會驅動它。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Platform.signal: 雙電磁閥且讀取兩個到位感測器。用於雷射頭的維修定位。在生產週期中絕不會被驅動。

MAIN.FG_01.Axis.name: Axis
MAIN.FG_01.Axis.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Kinematic axis carrying the laser head, driven by the Y_Platform service cylinder.

MAIN.FG_01.Axis.label: 第 1 站 · 軸
MAIN.FG_01.Axis.function: 承載雷射頭的運動軸，由 Y_Platform 維修氣缸驅動。

MAIN.FG_01.Y_LaserMark.name: Y_LaserMark
MAIN.FG_01.Y_LaserMark.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Signal: One control bit out enables the laser module; held high for 1 s it applies the mark. NO status bits - the PLC gets no confirmation that it fired.

MAIN.FG_01.Y_LaserMark.label: 第 1 站 · 雷射打標
MAIN.FG_01.Y_LaserMark.signal: 一個控制輸出位元啟用雷射模組；保持高電位 1 秒即執行打標。無狀態位元 — PLC 無法收到發射確認。

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gripper.name: Y_Gripper
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gripper.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Two finger clamp that holds the payload steady for the duration of marking and reading.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED clamps the payload for marking and reading; retracted releases.

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gripper.label: 第 1 站 · 夾爪氣缸
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gripper.function: 兩指夾具，在打標和讀碼期間將工件固定。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gripper.signal: 雙電磁閥且讀取兩個到位感測器。伸出夾緊工件以進行打標和讀碼；縮回則釋放。

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate1.name: Y_Gate1
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate1.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Guard gate cylinder. Closes to shield the cell during laser marking and opens to let pallets pass. Normal state gate opened (Home Position) (Top Position)
en.Signal: Extending CLOSES the gate, retracting OPENS it, and retracted is home - the opposite sense to a transport stopper. Both limits are read; the two gates are commanded together.
en.Role: Guard gate 1. Must be closed before the FG_01 laser may fire.

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate1.label: 第 1 站 · 閘門 1 氣缸
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate1.function: 防護閘門氣缸。在雷射打標期間關閉以遮蔽單元，並開啟以讓托盤通過。正常狀態為閘門開啟（原點位置）（頂部位置）。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate1.signal: 伸出關閉閘門，縮回開啟閘門，且縮回為原點 — 與輸送擋料器的方向相反。讀取兩個到位感測器；兩個閘門同步指令。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate1.role: 防護閘門 1。在功能群組 1 雷射發射前必須關閉。

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate2.name: Y_Gate2
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate2.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Guard gate cylinder. Closes to shield the cell during laser marking and opens to let pallets pass. Normal state gate opened (Home Position) (Top Position)
en.Signal: Extending CLOSES the gate, retracting OPENS it, and retracted is home - the opposite sense to a transport stopper. Both limits are read; the two gates are commanded together.
en.Role: Guard gate 2. Must be closed before the FG_01 laser may fire.

MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate2.label: 第 1 站 · 閘門 2 氣缸
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate2.function: 防護閘門氣缸。在雷射打標期間關閉以遮蔽單元，並開啟以讓托盤通過。正常狀態為閘門開啟（原點位置）（頂部位置）。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate2.signal: 伸出關閉閘門，縮回開啟閘門，且縮回為原點 — 與輸送擋料器的方向相反。讀取兩個到位感測器；兩個閘門同步指令。
MAIN.FG_01.Y_Gate2.role: 防護閘門 2。在功能群組 1 雷射發射前必須關閉。

MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate1.name: B_SafetyGate1
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate1.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Safety sensor monitoring a guard gate position.
en.Signal: Binary presence sensor. Monitors a guard gate. Must be Active, with both gates at their extended limit, before the laser may fire.
en.Role: Monitors guard gate 1 for the FG_01 laser interlock.

MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate1.label: 第 1 站 · 安全閘門感測器 1
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate1.function: 監控閘門位置的安全感測器。
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate1.signal: 二進位存在感測器。監控閘門。在雷射發射前，兩個閘門必須均處於伸出到位狀態且為啟動狀態。
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate1.role: 監控功能群組 1 雷射互鎖的安全閘門 1。

MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate2.name: B_SafetyGate2
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate2.groupLabel: 第 1 站：讀碼與雷射打標

en.Function: Safety sensor monitoring a guard gate position.
en.Signal: Binary presence sensor. Monitors a guard gate. Must be Active, with both gates at their extended limit, before the laser may fire.
en.Role: Monitors guard gate 2 for the FG_01 laser interlock.

MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate2.label: 第 1 站 · 安全閘門感測器 2
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate2.function: 監控閘門位置的安全感測器。
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate2.signal: 二進位存在感測器。監控閘門。在雷射發射前，兩個閘門必須均處於伸出到位狀態且為啟動狀態。
MAIN.FG_01.B_SafetyGate2.role: 監控功能群組 1 雷射互鎖的安全閘門 2。

MAIN.FG_02.name: FG_02

en.Function: Optical inspection. A camera above the pallet reads back the mark FG_01 applied and reports OK or not OK.

MAIN.FG_02.label: 第 2 站 · 光學檢測
MAIN.FG_02.function: 光學檢測。托盤上方的攝影機讀取功能群組 1 標記的內容並回報是否合格。

MAIN.FG_02.P_Camera.name: P_Camera

en.Function: Reads back the LaserMark datum FG_01 wrote onto the payload. This is the station that verifies the mark - FG_01 applies it and reads only the serial number.
en.Signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

MAIN.FG_02.P_Camera.label: 第 2 站 · 讀碼器
MAIN.FG_02.P_Camera.function: 讀取功能群組 1 寫入工件上的雷射打標數據。此站用於驗證標記——功能群組 1 負責打標並僅讀取序號。
MAIN.FG_02.P_Camera.signal: 啟用後觸發；讀回 Ready、Busy、ResultValid 和 ResultOK。孿生設備會回顯兩個控制位並交接數據；判定結果在 OC_SIM FB_Camera 中合成。

MAIN.FG_03.name: FG_03

en.Function: Transfers the part from slot 1 to slot 2 of the pallet, flipping it 180 degrees on the way. A newly created payload carries its part in slot 1 on the right hand side.

MAIN.FG_03.label: 第 3 站 · 工件轉移
MAIN.FG_03.function: 將工件從托盤的槽位 1 轉移到槽位 2，並在過程中翻轉 180 度。新建立的工件位於右側的槽位 1。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX1.name: Y_AxisX1

en.Function: VERTICAL axis for arm 1, despite the X in the name. Max is raised, and arm 1 stays there for the whole cycle; min is only the power-on rest position. Arm 2 names its axes the opposite way round.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is raised; arm 1 rises once and stays up for the whole cycle.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX1.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 X1 氣缸
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX1.function: 手臂 1 的垂直軸（儘管名稱中為 X）。最大值為升起，且手臂 1 在整個週期中保持該位置；最小值僅為上電後的靜止位置。手臂 2 的軸命名方式相反。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX1.signal: 雙電磁閥並讀取兩個到位訊號。MAX 為升起；手臂 1 升起一次後在整個週期中保持上升狀態。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX2.name: Y_AxisX2

en.Function: Horizontal traverse for arm 2, the picking arm.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is the transfer position, min is home over slot 1.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX2.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 X2 氣缸
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX2.function: 手臂 2（取料臂）的水平橫移。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisX2.signal: 雙電磁閥並讀取兩個到位訊號。MAX 為轉移位置，min 為槽位 1 上方的原點。

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_X1.name: Axis_X1

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the two arm transfer unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_X1.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 X1
MAIN.FG_03.Axis_X1.function: 雙臂轉移單元的運動學接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅承載運動，本身並非 PLC 設備。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY1.name: Y_AxisY1

en.Function: HORIZONTAL traverse for arm 1, despite the Y in the name. Min is home over slot 2, max is the transfer position. Arm 2 names its axes the opposite way round.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is the transfer position, min is home over slot 2.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY1.label: 第 3 站 · 氣缸 Y1
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY1.function: 手臂 1 的水平橫移，儘管名稱中帶有 Y。最小值為槽位 2 上方的原點，最大值為交接位置。手臂 2 的軸向命名方式相反。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY1.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位感測器皆被讀取。MAX 為交接位置，min 為槽位 2 上方的原點。

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_Y1.name: Axis_Y1

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the two arm transfer unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_Y1.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 Y1
MAIN.FG_03.Axis_Y1.function: 雙臂交接單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisR1.name: Y_AxisR1

en.Function: Rotates arm 1 through 180 degrees. Retracted (0 deg) is home and the receiving orientation; extended (180 deg) is the placing one. The flip is also what lowers the part into slot 2.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Rotary. Retracted is 0 deg and the receiving orientation; extended is 180 deg and the placing one.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisR1.label: 第 3 站 · 氣缸 R1
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisR1.function: 將手臂 1 旋轉 180 度。縮回 (0 度) 為原點且為接收方向；伸出 (180 度) 為放置方向。此翻轉動作同時將工件降低至槽位 2 中。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisR1.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位感測器皆被讀取。旋轉式。縮回為 0 度且為接收方向；伸出為 180 度且為放置方向。

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_R1.name: Axis_R1

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the two arm transfer unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_R1.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 R1
MAIN.FG_03.Axis_R1.function: 雙臂交接單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper1.name: Y_Gripper1

en.Function: Gripper on arm 1, the placing arm. Receives the part from arm 2 at the handover and releases it into slot 2.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught anything - only B_Detect1 says that.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper1.label: 第 3 站 · 夾爪氣缸 1
MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper1.function: 位於放置手臂（手臂 1）上的夾爪。在交接時從手臂 2 接收工件，並將其釋放到槽位 2 中。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper1.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位感測器皆被讀取。伸出為夾緊。到位感測器僅證明夾爪已移動，而非證明已夾取到物品——僅 B_Detect1 可確認此項。

MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect1.name: B_Detect1

en.Function: Grip sensor on arm 1, the placing arm. Reports whether Y_Gripper1 is actually holding the part, which the cylinder limit cannot.
en.Signal: Grip witness for arm 1. Active while gripper 1 actually holds the part.

MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect1.label: 第 3 站 · 夾取感測器 1
MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect1.function: 位於放置手臂（手臂 1）上的夾取感測器。回報 Y_Gripper1 是否實際持有工件，此為氣缸到位感測器無法達成的功能。
MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect1.signal: 手臂 1 的夾取確認。當夾爪 1 實際持有工件時為啟動狀態。

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_X2.name: Axis_X2

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the two arm transfer unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_X2.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 X2
MAIN.FG_03.Axis_X2.function: 雙臂交接單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY2.name: Y_AxisY2

en.Function: Vertical stroke for arm 2, lowering it to pick the part out of slot 1.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. The axis factor is inverted, so MAX is LOWERED.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY2.label: 第 3 站 · 氣缸 Y2
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY2.function: 手臂 2 的垂直行程，將其降低以從槽位 1 中取出工件。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_AxisY2.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位感測器皆被讀取。軸向因子為反向，因此 MAX 為降低位置。

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_Y2.name: Axis_Y2

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the two arm transfer unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_03.Axis_Y2.label: 第 3 站 · 軸 Y2
MAIN.FG_03.Axis_Y2.function: 雙臂交接單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅承載運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper2.name: Y_Gripper2

en.Function: Gripper on arm 2, the picking arm. Takes the part out of slot 1 and holds it until the handover to arm 1.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught anything - only B_Detect2 says that.

MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper2.label: 第 3 站 · 夾爪氣缸 2
MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper2.function: 取料臂（手臂 2）上的夾爪。將工件從槽位 1 取出並持有，直到交接給手臂 1。
MAIN.FG_03.Y_Gripper2.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位感測器皆被讀取。伸出為夾緊。到位感測器僅證明夾爪已移動，而非證明已夾到東西——僅 B_Detect2 可確認此項。

MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect2.name: B_Detect2

en.Function: Grip sensor on arm 2, the picking arm. Reports whether Y_Gripper2 is actually holding the part, which the cylinder limit cannot.
en.Signal: Grip witness for arm 2. Active while gripper 2 actually holds the part.

MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect2.label: 第 3 站 · 夾取感測器 2
MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect2.function: 取料臂（手臂 2）上的夾取感測器。回報 Y_Gripper2 是否確實持有工件，此為氣缸到位感測器無法達成的功能。
MAIN.FG_03.B_Detect2.signal: 手臂 2 的夾取確認。當夾爪 2 確實持有工件時為啟動狀態。

MAIN.FG_04.name: FG_04
MAIN.FG_04.groupLabel: 第 4 站：壓入與到位檢查

en.Function: Presses the part home into its slot and checks that it seated correctly.

MAIN.FG_04.label: 第 4 站
MAIN.FG_04.function: 將工件壓入其槽位並檢查是否正確就位。

MAIN.FG_04.Y_AxisZ.name: Y_AxisZ
MAIN.FG_04.Y_AxisZ.groupLabel: 第 4 站：壓入與到位檢查

en.Function: Press cylinder. Strokes down to seat the part in its slot, holds 1 s, then retracts.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED presses down onto the part; retracted is clear. A double solenoid so an abort leaves it where it is.

MAIN.FG_04.Y_AxisZ.label: 第 4 站 · 壓料氣缸 Z 軸
MAIN.FG_04.Y_AxisZ.function: 壓料氣缸。向下行程將工件壓入槽位，保持 1 秒後縮回。
MAIN.FG_04.Y_AxisZ.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位感測器皆被讀取。伸出為向下壓向工件；縮回為脫離。使用雙電磁閥是為了在中止時使其保持原位。

MAIN.FG_04.B_NIO.name: B_NIO
MAIN.FG_04.B_NIO.groupLabel: 第 4 站：壓入與到位檢查

en.Function: Not in order signal for the press. PartPressDetector raises it when the press cylinder has reached its bottom limit but the seating sensor sees no part - press completed with nothing correctly seated.
en.Signal: A VERDICT, not a sensor reading. Active means the press bottomed with nothing correctly seated. Only meaningful at the bottom limit with the hold expired.

MAIN.FG_04.B_NIO.label: 第 4 站 · 不良品感測器
MAIN.FG_04.B_NIO.function: 壓料裝置的不良品訊號。當壓料氣缸到達底部到位位置，但就位感測器未偵測到工件時，由 PartPressDetector 觸發——表示壓料完成但無工件正確就位。
MAIN.FG_04.B_NIO.signal: 這是一個判定結果，而非感測器讀值。啟動表示壓料到底但無工件正確就位。僅在底部到位且保持時間結束後才有意義。

MAIN.FG_04.Sensor.name: Sensor
MAIN.FG_04.Sensor.groupLabel: 第 4 站：壓入與到位檢查

en.Function: Seating sensor under the press. Detects that a part is present and correctly seated.
en.Signal: Not a PLC symbol - its Link is disabled. It feeds PartPressDetector locally, which publishes the result to the PLC as B_NIO.

MAIN.FG_04.Sensor.label: 第 4 站 · 就位感測器
MAIN.FG_04.Sensor.function: 壓料裝置下方的就位感測器。偵測工件是否存在且正確就位。
MAIN.FG_04.Sensor.signal: 非 PLC 符號——其連結已禁用。它在本地將訊號傳給 PartPressDetector，再由後者將結果作為 B_NIO 發布至 PLC。

MAIN.FG_05.name: FG_05

en.Function: Fits a cap from the bunker onto the part carried on the pallet.

MAIN.FG_05.label: 第 5 站
MAIN.FG_05.function: 將瓶蓋從料倉安裝到托盤承載的工件上。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisX.name: Y_AxisX

en.Function: Horizontal traverse between the cap pick position and the pallet.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is over the pallet, min is over the cap feed.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisX.label: 第 5 站 · X 軸氣缸
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisX.function: 在瓶蓋取料位置與托盤之間進行水平移動。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisX.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位皆有讀取。MAX 為托盤上方，min 為瓶蓋供料上方。

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_X.name: Axis_X

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the cap handling unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_X.label: 第 5 站 · X 軸
MAIN.FG_05.Axis_X.function: 瓶蓋處理單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ1.name: Y_AxisZ1

en.Function: Vertical stroke on the pallet side, lowering the cap onto the part.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED lowers the cap onto the part on the pallet side.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ1.label: 第 5 站 · Z1 軸氣缸
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ1.function: 托盤側的垂直行程，將瓶蓋放置於工件上。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ1.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位皆有讀取。伸出時將瓶蓋放置於托盤側的工件上。

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_Z1.name: Axis_Z1

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the cap handling unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_Z1.label: 第 5 站 · Z1 軸
MAIN.FG_05.Axis_Z1.function: 瓶蓋處理單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ2.name: Y_AxisZ2

en.Function: Vertical stroke on the bunker side, lowering the gripper to pick a cap.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED lowers to the cap at the pick position on the feed side.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ2.label: 第 5 站 · Z2 軸氣缸
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ2.function: 料倉側的垂直行程，降低夾爪以取瓶蓋。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisZ2.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位皆有讀取。伸出時降低至供料側取料位置的瓶蓋。

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_Z2.name: Axis_Z2

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the cap handling unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_Z2.label: 第 5 站 · Z2 軸
MAIN.FG_05.Axis_Z2.function: 瓶蓋處理單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisR.name: Y_AxisR

en.Function: Rotates the cap into its fitting orientation before placement.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Rotary. Extended is the fitting orientation, retracted is home.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisR.label: 第 5 站 · R 軸氣缸
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisR.function: 在放置前將瓶蓋旋轉至適配方向。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_AxisR.signal: 雙電磁閥且兩個到位皆有讀取。旋轉式。伸出為適配方向，縮回為原點。

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_R.name: Axis_R

en.Function: Kinematic joint of the cap handling unit, driven by the matching Y_ cylinder. Carries motion only and is not a PLC device in its own right.

MAIN.FG_05.Axis_R.label: 第 5 站 · R 軸
MAIN.FG_05.Axis_R.function: 瓶蓋處理單元的運動接頭，由對應的 Y_ 氣缸驅動。僅傳遞運動，本身並非 PLC 裝置。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_Gripper.name: Y_Gripper

en.Function: Gripper that holds the cap from pick through to placement on the part.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips the cap. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught one - only B_Detect says that.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_Gripper.label: 第 5 站 · 夾爪
MAIN.FG_05.Y_Gripper.function: 夾爪，用於將瓶蓋從拾取位置持有至放置在工件上。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_Gripper.signal: 雙電磁閥且讀取兩個到位感測器。伸出為夾住瓶蓋。到位感測器僅證明夾爪已移動，而非證明已夾到瓶蓋——僅 B_Detect 可確認此項。

MAIN.FG_05.B_Detect.name: B_Detect

en.Function: Grip sensor in the jaws of Y_Gripper. Reports whether this unit is carrying a cap - not whether one is available, which is B_Part on the feed.
en.Signal: Grip witness in the jaws. Active while this unit carries a cap. NOT the same question as B_Part.

MAIN.FG_05.B_Detect.label: 第 5 站 · 夾持感測器
MAIN.FG_05.B_Detect.function: 位於 Y_Gripper 夾爪中的夾持感測器。回報此單元是否攜帶瓶蓋，而非回報是否有瓶蓋可用（後者為進料端的 B_Part）。
MAIN.FG_05.B_Detect.signal: 夾爪中的夾持確認感測器。當此單元攜帶瓶蓋時為啟動狀態。與 B_Part 的目的不同。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSourceStopper.name: Y_CapsSourceStopper

en.Function: Stopper on the cap feed conveyor. Holds the next cap at the pick position.
en.Signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED BLOCKS the feed path and the queue accumulates against it. The opposite sense to a transport stopper.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSourceStopper.label: 第 5 站 · 瓶蓋源擋料氣缸
MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSourceStopper.function: 瓶蓋進料輸送帶上的擋料器。將下一個瓶蓋保持在拾取位置。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSourceStopper.signal: 雙電磁閥且讀取兩個到位感測器。伸出時阻斷進料路徑，且隊列將在其後方堆積。其邏輯與輸送帶擋料器相反。

MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSource.name: Y_CapsSource

en.Function: Cap bunker. Feeds small caps onto the short conveyor that presents them at the pick position.
en.Signal: Two bool outputs from the PLC and no status bits - the bunker reports nothing back. MIL turns both on together for as long as it is enabled.

MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSource.label: 第 5 站 · 瓶蓋料倉
MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSource.function: 瓶蓋料倉。將小瓶蓋輸送至短輸送帶，以便將其呈現在拾取位置。
MAIN.FG_05.Y_CapsSource.signal: 來自 PLC 的兩個布林輸出且無狀態位——料倉不回報任何資訊。當啟用時，MIL 會同時開啟這兩個輸出。

MAIN.FG_05.P_Camera.name: P_Camera

en.Function: Identification read of the ASSEMBLY on the pallet, not of the cap. Mounted on the feed side, looking across at the pallet; returns the assembly CapsID.
en.Signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

MAIN.FG_05.P_Camera.label: 第 5 站 · 讀碼器
MAIN.FG_05.P_Camera.function: 對托盤上的組件進行識別讀取，而非讀取瓶蓋。安裝在進料側並對向觀察托盤；回傳組件的 CapsID。
MAIN.FG_05.P_Camera.signal: 啟用後觸發；回傳 Ready, Busy, ResultValid 與 ResultOK。孿生設備會回顯這兩個控制位並交接數據；判定結果在 OC_SIM FB_Camera 中合成。

MAIN.FG_05.B_Part.name: B_Part

en.Function: Presence sensor at the cap pick position. The station waits for this before starting a cycle.
en.Signal: Binary presence sensor. On the FEED: a cap has arrived at the pick position. Once the gripper lifts one away it reports the NEXT one.

MAIN.FG_05.B_Part.label: 第 5 站 · 工件感測器
MAIN.FG_05.B_Part.function: 瓶蓋拾取位置的到位感測器。該站會在開始循環前等待此訊號。
MAIN.FG_05.B_Part.signal: 二進位到位感測器。在進料端：表示瓶蓋已到達拾取位置。一旦夾爪將其移走，它將回報下一個瓶蓋。
